overall.summary: Numbers, coverage and all 140 claims reproduce; one technical evidence statement (area415_state47 'zero in area 415') is contradicted by 30 Washington customers, and several plain sentences mis-scope a subgroup (Ohio), attribute a whole-model change to one part (Washington), or rest on out-of-support inputs (voice-mail messages).

findings.statement: 595 ... Zero in area 415 (2,016 rows)
findings.check: subgroup on area code 415 and on Washington within 415; probe state x area code
findings.evidence: The part is on for 30 of the 2016 area-415 customers (all 30 Washington customers in area 415): exit 595 = 1.03, contribution +0.21 logit (subgroup mean 0.210). Only 1986 area-415 rows are zero.
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify subgroup experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-2459d3 --where "`area code` == '415'"
uv run python -m explaneat verify subgroup experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-2459d3 --where "state == '47' and `area code` == '415'"
uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-2459d3 --sweep state=49,47 --sweep 'area code=415,408'

findings.statement: small positive offset (~0.15) outside 415, larger (~+3) for state 47 outside 415, zero in area 415
findings.check: probe state=47 x area code (typical customer)
findings.evidence: Offsets reproduce (0.106 for WV outside 415, 3.19 for Washington outside 415), but 'zero in area 415' fails for Washington: 1.03 in area 415 (logit +0.21, about a third of the +0.65 outside 415). Rule has 30 real counterexamples.
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-2459d3 --sweep state=49,47 --sweep 'area code=415,408'

findings.statement: For such a customer [Washington, outside 415] the chance rises from about 3% to about 14%.
findings.check: ablate ann_85 --to zero for the typical Washington area-408 customer
findings.evidence: C114 reproduces (2.7% -> 14.3%), but that is the whole-model change of moving to Washington outside 415; most of it comes from the backbone's state-47 term (ann_80 contribution -0.136 -> +1.022). This part alone moves the typical Washington/408 customer from 8.9% to 15.8% (+0.65 logit). Sentence attributes the full change to the part. Same wording in drafted.blocks[6].
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify ablate experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-2459d3 --part ann_85 --to zero --hold "where:state == '47' and `area code` == '408'" --where "state == '47'"

findings.statement: For customers in Ohio, daytime minutes add to the chance only above about 85 minutes, in an uneven way, from about 2% to about 7%.
findings.check: probe day-minutes sweep at 2 calls, state West Virginia vs Ohio
findings.evidence: The part does not read Ohio (its state input is Oregon only). ann_81 contributions are identical in WV and Ohio (+0.540 flat to 80 min, +0.631 at 100, +1.379 at 220). The fold at about 85 minutes applies to any 2-call customer; 'Ohio' is an artefact of the 32 sampled patients. Numbers reproduce (C095), the subgroup is wrong. Same sentence in drafted.blocks[2].
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-2459d3 --set state=49 --set 'number customer service calls=2' --sweep 'total day minutes=60,80,100,120,160,220,270'
uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-2459d3 --set state=35 --set 'number customer service calls=2' --sweep 'total day minutes=60,80,100,120,160,220,270'

findings.statement: more voice-mail messages raise it steadily, to about 13% at 32 messages
findings.check: subgroup on no plan with messages > 0; probe messages sweep for plan holders
findings.evidence: C053 reproduces, but it is computed for a customer with no voice-mail plan, and no training customer without a plan has any messages (n = 0): pure extrapolation. For plan holders (typical plan holder) the model goes 0.3% at 10, 0.8% at 29, 1.9% at 45 messages. Direction holds, size is out of support. Same in drafted.blocks[0] and drafted.readdown.ann_80.hypothesis[0].
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify subgroup experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-2459d3 --where "`voice mail plan` == '0' and `number vmail messages` > 0"
uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-2459d3 --hold "where:`voice mail plan` == '1'" --sweep 'number vmail messages=10,29,45'

findings.statement: the state moves the chance by several points (for example Montana and Oregon high, Vermont and Wyoming low)
findings.check: probe state sweep, typical customer, whole model; CSC sweep in Oregon
findings.evidence: Oregon is high only through the backbone (C055, 9%). In the whole model the typical (1-call) Oregon customer is at 1.7% vs 2.7% in WV (C027 lowers), because Oregon switches off the CSC unit (ann_81 contribution -0.712 vs +1.064). Oregon is higher only from 2-3 calls on (5.8% vs 2.9% at 2 calls; 17.6% vs 5.4% at 3). Montana, Vermont, Wyoming hold (10.3%, 0.6%, 1.3%).
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-2459d3 --sweep state=49,41,44,21,11,0,37,26,46,50
uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-2459d3 --set state=37 --sweep 'number customer service calls=0,1,2,3,4,5,6'
